title: Register as a real estate agent
what: Be named on the register as a real estate agent before carrying on real estate agency business; property management business needs a registered property manager (s 35).

laws.title: Property Agents and Land Transactions Act 2016 (Tas)

sources.title: Property Agents and Land Transactions Act 2016 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on all or any part of real estate agency business, or hold himself or herself out as prepared to do so, unless he or she is a real estate agent named in Part 1(1) of the Register
